commands.label: Find references
commands.description: Lists every reference to the symbol under the cursor; jumps straight there if there is only one.
examples: Cursor on save, grr → every call of save is listed

deviation.shadows: Vim gr{char} (replace virtual characters), which neither VSCodeVim nor IdeaVim implements
deviation.note: Clashes with the opt-in ReplaceWithRegister gr and grr (VSCodeVim vim.replaceWithRegister, IdeaVim ReplaceWithRegister).

commands.label: Go to implementation
commands.description: Jumps to the implementation of the interface, abstract method or type under the cursor; lists them if there are several.
examples: Cursor on an interface method, gri → jumps to its implementation

deviation.shadows: Vim gr{char} (replace virtual characters), which neither VSCodeVim nor IdeaVim implements
deviation.note: Clashes with the opt-in ReplaceWithRegister gr and grr (VSCodeVim vim.replaceWithRegister, IdeaVim ReplaceWithRegister).

commands.label: List symbols in file
commands.description: Lists the classes, methods and fields of the current file; type to filter and press Enter to jump.
examples: gO, type parse → jumps to parseConfig
commands.rationale: Neovim 0.11 maps gO to document symbols.

deviation.shadows: VSCodeVim's built-in gO, which focuses the Outline view and leaves the editor
